warnings: One of 5 views on this sheet; siblings are the plan (_view1_fence_type1_plan.json), column C1 detail (_view2_fence_type1_column_c1_detail.json), front elevation (_view4_fence_type1_front_elevation.json), and section (_view5_fence_type1_section.json).

GB (a beam-type member, not a column) correctly uses the top/bottom main_bar split per spec §6/§7, unlike C1 which correctly uses the column single-count exception -- both conventions applied deliberately, not interchangeably.

This 200x300mm GB size, combined with view5's 'รูปตัด' section, resolves against หน้า26's own front-elevation height ladder: the ladder's 0.10+0.10+0.10=0.30 sub-segment near ground level matches GB's own 300mm depth exactly (see view4's warnings).
